name: Gide
blurb: Better living with practical tools and AI guides.
description: Gide creates practical apps and plain-English AI guides for safer, calmer, and more confident everyday living.

apps.name: Gide Guard
apps.summary: Helps you think through safety concerns, recognize suspicious situations, and stay aware of scams, fraud, and risk.

apps.name: Gide Calm
apps.tagline: A pause when you need one.
apps.summary: Simple calming tools, reflections, and support for stressful moments when you need to pause and reset.

apps.name: Gide Faith
apps.summary: Scripture, prayer, reflection, and faith-based encouragement for daily spiritual growth.

apps.name: Gide Stride
apps.summary: Encourages movement, progress, and personal growth by turning steps and goals into visible progress.

apps.name: Gide Legacy
apps.summary: Preserve voices, photos, stories, and relationships in a private archive your family controls.

apps.name: Gide Roots
apps.summary: Build and preserve the people, relationships, and generations that give your family story its structure.

books.title: AI Won’t Replace You
books.summary: A practical introduction to AI, effective prompting, verification, privacy, and staying relevant.
books.tagline: A practical introduction to artificial intelligence for everyday people.
books.hook: Turn AI into an assistant, not an authority.
books.hookBody: Understand AI as a prediction tool, learn effective prompting, recognize confident false answers, and use independent sources to verify important information.
inside: A clear, non-technical explanation of modern AI
Prompting techniques for more useful results
Privacy rules for medical, financial, and workplace information
A practical mindset for staying productive and relevant

books.title: AI for Everyday Life
books.summary: Use AI for household planning, learning, career tasks, decisions, and everyday organization.
books.tagline: A practical guide to making AI useful at home and throughout your day.
books.hook: Use natural language to get practical help.
books.hookBody: Learn how tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini can support household management, career efficiency, learning, and better-prepared decisions.
inside: Clear prompts with useful context
Household, career, and learning examples
Decision-support frameworks
Safety guidance for AI-driven scams and private information

books.title: AI at Work
books.summary: Apply the 5D Work System to draft, digest, decide, design, and delegate more effectively.
books.tagline: The 5D System for practical, responsible productivity.
books.hookBody: Learn to Draft, Digest, Decide, Design, and Delegate routine tasks with AI while keeping data security, accuracy, and human judgment at the center.
inside: A repeatable 5D productivity framework
Examples for several industries and job types
Guidance for avoiding hallucinations and protecting workplace data
Ideas for reducing administrative load and burnout

books.title: AI Safety and Scam Prevention
books.summary: Recognize voice cloning, deepfakes, phishing, and other AI-powered fraud tactics.
books.tagline: Practical protection for families in the age of synthetic media.
books.hook: Protect trust from new forms of fraud.
books.hookBody: Understand how scammers use voice cloning, deepfake video, sophisticated phishing, and emotional urgency - then build simple defenses before a crisis happens.
inside: Family code words and verification habits
The SIFT method for checking information
Warning signs in AI-generated media
Password managers, two-factor authentication, and safer responses

books.title: AI for Veterans
books.summary: Use AI to understand benefits, prepare questions, translate military skills, and navigate services.
books.tagline: A practical guide to benefits, services, careers, and better-prepared questions.
books.hookBody: Use AI as a research and preparation assistant for understanding complex benefit language, exploring services, and translating military experience for civilian opportunities.
inside: Plain-English help with dense benefit information
Preparation for VA claims and personal statements
Healthcare, career, and state-level benefit research
Clear limits: AI does not replace accredited VSOs, attorneys, or medical professionals

books.title: The AI Gold Rush
books.summary: See through get-rich-quick claims and focus on genuine value instead of opportunity-industry hype.
books.tagline: Who is really getting rich - and what creates genuine value?
books.hook: Look beyond the promise of effortless wealth.
books.hookBody: Explore how influencers, marketing funnels, and survivorship bias can make AI opportunities appear easier and more profitable than they really are.
inside: Lessons from historical gold rushes
How opportunity-industry marketing funnels work
The difference between gross revenue and actual profit
A framework for evaluating whether an AI idea solves a real problem

podcast.title: Mastering AI as a Practical Prediction Machine
podcast.summary: Understand what AI really does, where human judgment matters, and how to use the technology with clearer expectations.

podcast.title: Stop Treating AI Like a Search Engine
podcast.summary: Move from short keyword searches to contextual conversations that produce more useful and relevant results.

podcast.title: Reclaim Fifteen Hours Weekly with AI
podcast.summary: Apply practical workflows to reduce repetitive work and create more time for judgment, relationships, and high-value tasks.

podcast.title: How AI Voice Clones Fool Your Brain
podcast.summary: Learn why voice cloning feels convincing, how scammers create urgency, and why a second trusted channel matters.

podcast.title: Hack Veterans Benefits with Everyday AI
podcast.summary: Use AI to translate VA complexity, prepare clearer statements, research benefits, and support the human experts on your team.

podcast.title: The Trap of AI Passive Income
podcast.summary: A grounded look at AI gold-rush promises, survivorship bias, lead magnets, expenses, and the value test.
